# mtncloud_load_balancer_health_monitor (Data Source)

Looks up one health monitor of a load balancer by ID or by name. Pick the load balancer by ID or name. A monitor's name is often empty; look it up by ID then, or read it from its pool.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_network" "app" {
  name = "app-net"
}

data "mtncloud_load_balancer_health_monitor" "web" {
  network_id         = data.mtncloud_network.app.id
  load_balancer_name = "web-lb"
  name               = "web-check"
}

output "check_path" {
  value = data.mtncloud_load_balancer_health_monitor.web.url_path
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `network_id` (Number) ID of the MTN Network the load balancer is on, for example `mtncloud_network.app.id`. Your tenant must own the network or have it shared with it.

### Optional

- `id` (String) The health monitor's ID. Give this or `name`.
- `load_balancer_id` (String) Load balancer ID. Give this or `load_balancer_name`.
- `load_balancer_name` (String) Load balancer name, matched exactly; it must match exactly one on the network. Give this or `load_balancer_id`.
- `name` (String) The health monitor's name, matched exactly. Give this or `id`.

### Read-Only

- `delay` (Number) Seconds between checks.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether it is administratively up.
- `expected_codes` (String) HTTP status codes that count as up, for example `200` or `200-204`, or empty.
- `http_method` (String) HTTP method for `HTTP` and `HTTPS` checks, or empty.
- `max_retries` (Number) Successful checks in a row before a member is marked up.
- `max_retries_down` (Number) Failed checks in a row before a member is marked down.
- `operating_status` (String) `ONLINE`, `OFFLINE`, `DEGRADED`, `ERROR` or `NO_MONITOR`.
- `pool_id` (String) ID of the pool it checks.
- `pool_name` (String) Name of the pool it checks.
- `provisioning_status` (String) `ACTIVE`, or `PENDING_CREATE`, `PENDING_UPDATE`, `PENDING_DELETE` while a change is applied, or `ERROR`.
- `timeout` (Number) Seconds a check may take.
- `type` (String) `HTTP`, `HTTPS`, `PING`, `TCP`, `TLS-HELLO` or `UDP-CONNECT`.
- `url_path` (String) Path requested by `HTTP` and `HTTPS` checks, or empty.
